parameters.filterByFormula: AND({Status}='Active', IS_AFTER({Renewal Date}, TODAY()), IS_BEFORE({Renewal Date}, DATEADD(TODAY(), 60, 'days')), {Upsell Email Sent}=FALSE())

parameters.text:
=Analyze this customer and determine the best upsell approach for their upcoming renewal.

Customer: {{ JSON.stringify($('Fetch Renewal Candidates').item.json.fields) }}
Usage: {{ JSON.stringify($('Fetch Usage Signals').all().map(i=>i.json)) }}

Analyze:
1. Are they hitting plan limits? (upsell to higher tier)
2. Are they using only basic features? (upsell with training offer)
3. Do they have multiple team members? (upsell to team plan)
4. High ROI usage? (ask for case study + offer discount on annual)

Return JSON:
{
  "upsell_type": "tier_upgrade/annual_upgrade/team_expansion/training",
  "upsell_reason": "one line why this makes sense for them",
  "suggested_plan": "",
  "current_plan": "",
  "discount_offer": "10% annual / free onboarding / etc",
  "email_subject": "",
  "email_body": "personalized 150 word email body mentioning their usage and the offer",
  "send_email": true/false
}

parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Renewal Upsell Trigger
Runs daily. Finds customers within 60 days of renewal.
GPT-4o analyzes usage to find best upsell angle:
- Hitting limits → tier upgrade
- Low usage → training offer
- Team use → team plan
- High ROI → annual discount
Sends personalized email + logs to Slack.
